## Problem / why

What is awkward or missing today, and who feels it (kitchen iPad, phone)?

## Proposed behaviour

What should happen instead? Describe it from the user's side first.

## Design notes

- Where it lives (page, Settings section, module).
- Data it needs (new table or setting, migration number).
- Anything it must stay compatible with.

## Constraints to respect

- [ ] Works on the kitchen iPad (iOS 9.3.5 Safari): server-rendered, no JavaScript, flexbox and margins only, 44px touch targets
- [ ] Works on a phone from the same URLs
- [ ] No third-party recipe content or personal data committed to the repo

## Done when

- [ ] Tests written first, covering the behaviour above
- [ ] Checks pass (ruff, mypy, bandit, unit tests)
- [ ] Tried on the iPad

Links to issues or PRs.
